This suggests a possible mechanistic link between Somatotropin and PWS, possibly through shared pathways in growth regulation or developmental processes. The evidence is strengthened by the presence of a direct indication from Somatotropin to PWS via Noonan Syndrome and Fluoxymesterone, which implies a possible role of Somatotropin in the pathophysiology of PWS.
